issue_context.title: Cleanup Job controller unit tests for requeuing with delay
issue_context.body:
/sig apps

In many unit tests we set `DefaultJobBackOff` and `syncJobBatchPeriod` to 0. However, this is problematic, because the mechanism works differently when the delay is 0 and when it is >0. When the delay is 0 the delay is immediate and the unit tests can assert if the requeueing was immediate, which makes them easier to right, but making them far from the real running system. 

Examples:
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/fa78f28f0a011e9922cf12145dd602c5a63981e8/pkg/controller/job/job_controller_test.go#L3473
-  https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/fa78f28f0a011e9922cf12145dd602c5a63981e8/pkg/controller/job/job_controller_test.go#L3110

One complication though with simply passing the fake clock is described here, and may result in flakiness, so this should be done carefully: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/114944#discussion_r1069179801
